description: Source code for the 'agents' component in the Mattermost server, handling plugin bridge interactions, agent retrieval, and LLM service fetching.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing methods for plugin bridge interactions and agent management.

methods.name: GetBridgeClient
methods.description: Returns a bridge client for making requests to the plugin bridge API.

methods.name: GetAIPluginBridgeStatus
methods.description: Checks if the mattermost-ai plugin is active and supports the bridge API (v1.5.0+).

methods.name: GetAgents
methods.description: Retrieves all available agents from the bridge API.

methods.name: GetUsersForAgents
methods.description: Retrieves User objects for all available agents.

methods.name: GetLLMServices
methods.description: Retrieves all available LLM services from the bridge API.
